name: Working days
summary: Count working days, Indian financial year
author: friday-core
description: Counts working days between two dates (both included), finds the date N working days away, and reports the weekday, ISO week, Indian financial year (1 April to 31 March), quarter and assessment year. Weekend can be Saturday-Sunday, Friday-Saturday, Sunday only or none. Public holidays are never guessed: pass them as a list of dates. Dates are read as year-month-day or day-month-year.
